description.zh:
作為一名未來的運動員，您剛開始為即將舉行的賽事進行練習。 鑑於您在第一天跑了 x 英里，到了比賽時您必須能夠跑 y 英里。

計算您最終達到活動所需距離所需的天數（如果您 每天將您的距離比前一天增加 10%。

列印一個整數，表示達到所需距離的天數。

C++ 注意：對於以零結尾的輸入，請勿包含結尾零。當結果可能是小數時，請使用 double。
description.en:
As a future athlete you just started your practice for an upcoming event. Given that on the first day you run x miles, and by the event you must be able to run y miles.

Calculate the number of days required for you to finally reach the required distance for the event, if you increases your distance each day by 10% from the previous day.

Print one integer representing the number of days to reach the required distance.

C++ note: For zero-terminated input, do not include the terminating zero. Use double when the result may be fractional.

hint.zh: 輸入以 0 結束的題目不要把結尾的 0 納入統計；需要小數結果時使用 double。
hint.en: For zero-terminated input, do not include the terminating zero. Use double when the result may be fractional.
